entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent
 Mr. Prashant Hagare for the applicants.
 Mrs. Rutuja Ambekar, App for the respondent/State.
 Coram : Amit Borkar, J.
 Dated : June 20, 2023
 P.C.:
1.

This is an application seeking relief of pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 in connection with C.R. No.988 of 2021 registered with Yavat Police Station, Taluka Daund, District Pune for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 304B, 306, 323, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. On perusal of the report and the charge-sheet filed against other accused, it appears that the allegation against the applicants is to the effect that they physically and mentally harassed the deceased who ultimately committed suicide.
On perusal of the panchanama, postmortem report and other material, it appears that detailed investigation from all angles is required.
However, at this stage considering the material on record as of today, the 17-aba1676-2023.doc applicants deserve to be protected by way of interim order.

Hence, following order:
a) Till 17 July 2023, in the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with C.R.
No.988 of 2021 registered with Yavat Police Station, Taluka Daund, District Pune for Mina @ R. S. Digambar Kale And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49570784/
1 the offences punishable under Section 498A, 304B, 306, 323, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, they be released on interim bail on furnishing P.R. Bond in the amount of Rs.50,000/- each along with one or two sureties in the like amount;
b) The applicants shall remain present before the investigating officer on 22, 26 and 28 June 2023, and thereafter as and when called upon by the concerned investigating officer.
3. List the anticipatory bail application on 17 July 2023.
